title: Requirements Parse
statement: Implement `solve(lines)`. Each line is a string. Ignore blank lines and lines whose stripped text starts with `#`. Every remaining line has the form `name==version`. Return a list of `[name, version]` pairs in order, with surrounding whitespace removed from both sides.
hints: Strip the line before you decide it is blank or a comment.
Split on == once. A version will not contain that separator in these tests.
Keep the original order. Do not sort.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A requirements file is a line protocol.

editorial: A requirements file is a line protocol. Comments and blanks are not packages. Splitting a pinned line on == is enough for the direct-dependency pins this course uses. Ranges and extras are out of scope.
